rule: Each section: (1) pdftotext the SLK manual chapter, (2) rebuild notes terse (~15-20k chars, one point per line, citations only in cases array), (3) add visuals array - overview mind map + one per topic + decision trees for confusable doctrines, (4) preserve/relocate MCQ traps, never delete, (5) verify with node buildVis sweep, (6) push.

sections.notes: was flagged aligned-needs-visuals but the section was actually BROKEN: every note body was a plain string, not an array, so buildCh's (n.body||[]).map threw and the section would not render. Bodies converted to arrays - it was the only section in the file with this defect. Also removed invented content (Eccles v Bryant, LPA 1925 s.52, LRR 2003 - none in the chapter) and fixed the statutes/cases arrays, which held bare strings instead of {ref,text}/{name,citation,rule} objects and rendered blank. Corrected the postal-exchange rule: binding when the SELLER'S part is posted, not 'on the posting date'. Added the missing manual material: max 4 legal owners/legal estate is always a joint tenancy, overreaching and the second trustee, the full pre-exchange checklists for both solicitors, cleared deposit funds and the SRA Accounts Rules, the redemption-figure undertaking, memorandum contents, implied undertakings, estate contract (notice v C(iv)), risk and the seller's continuing duty, occupation before completion (SC licensee v SCPC silence) and simultaneous exchange and completion. Single steps visual replaced with an array of 8 (3 mind maps, 3 decision trees, 1 grid, 1 steps). Object is 26k chars, above the 15-20k target, because the chapter has 15 subsections and 8 visuals.
